title: Silent virtual-host configuration
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a type of states, and let $x,y$ be finite Boolean strings. For a configuration $c$ with $m$ work tapes on input $y$, a Boolean $b$, an input-head position $p$ for $x$, and Boolean strings $\mathrm{capPre}$ and $\mathrm{out}_0$, define the silent virtual-host configuration by applying the silent-configuration embedding to the virtual-host configuration of $c$ with tag $b$, position $p$, and empty output, using the designated cap tape, cap prefix $\mathrm{capPre}$, and output prefix $\mathrm{out}_0$, with the added tape blank everywhere and its head at position zero.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration with $m$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and states in $S$, on input $y$
caveat: The supplied definitions do not specify the behavior of the silent-configuration embedding or the virtual-host construction, so those operations can only be named, not explained further.
